Author: VamprincessDorene
Name: Flip Cup
Punchline: Play flip cup with your friends on any counter in your house.
Description: Turns 8 placed cup furnishings (Tankards work great) into a game of flip cup for two teams of 4. Click to chug, click to flip: 50/50 to land rim-down. First team to flip all 4 cups wins. One player hosts with /flipcup host, friends join with /flipcup join CODE and see every flip in sync. Flips are visual only and never change your house. Type /flipcup to open.
